title: Polycrystalline κ-Ga2O3 on Si(100) substrates with GZO buffer layers
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16595-16600
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00464D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yoshiaki Hirai, Htet Su Wai, Toshiyuki Kawaharamura, Noriaki Ikenaga, Osamu Ueda, Hiroyuki Nishinaka
Polycrystalline κ-Ga2O3 was successfully deposited on a Si substrate using a GZO buffer layer. Furthermore, it was revealed that a ZnGa2O4 transition layer forms during the growth process.
